desc: The only open Senate hearing on AARO under its first director, held 19 April 2023 before the Senate Armed Services Subcommittee on Emerging Threats and Capabilities chaired by Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand, published as S.Hrg. 118-648. Sean Kirkpatrick testified that AARO was investigating more than 650 cases and that spherical objects made up nearly half of all UAP reports the office had received. His testimony that AARO had found no credible evidence of extraterrestrial activity or of objects defying known physics generated immediate controversy over what the office had actually examined versus what it had asserted. The hearing occurred three months before David Grusch testified in the House, and it is the last moment at which the Department's account went unchallenged in a congressional venue.
